facts.fact: The paper states SiGIT, Mozambique's land information management system, had processed 1,375,586 individual parcels and 826 community delimitations in the national land cadastre up to March 2020.
The paper states SiGIT incorporated land legislation into its workflows for all land administration processes from registration to taxation, including transmission of rights.

systems.platform: ISO 19152 LADM-based back office with mobile and cloud apps
systems.owner: National Directorate of Land; lifecycle run by EXI Lda
